title: Compatibility clients and retained data
summary: Published V1 issue/board/media operations remain a distinct API/MCP surface. Current native web routes use V2 where available; compatibility projection is not permission to rewrite custom identities.

cases.title: Read V1 issue projection
preconditions: The caller has current read access and all projects in the requested scope are compatible legacy-mode projects.
steps: Read an authorized issue through get_issue.
expected: The retained V1 representation is returned; it is not the native typed-choice editor contract.
notes: Compatibility-surface case; do not infer a native browser control or full custom-choice support from this published operation.
